summary.text: Krissy Guess is the Democratic candidate for Texas House District 60 in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Republican Mike Olcott.
She works in operations at a Texas lighting manufacturer and distributor.

paragraphs.text: Guess graduated from Azle High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Tarleton State University in 2004 and a graduate degree from the University of Texas at Arlington in 2010.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was born and raised in Texas House District 60, is the mother of three daughters, and has worked for more than two decades at Litex Industries in Grand Prairie, where she oversees operations.
Guess named women's health, fully funding public schools and protecting local water supplies, including concerns about data centers, among her campaign messages.
She listed rural health care, public school funding, opposition to data centers and affordability as her policy priorities.
